alternatives: A100 power capping changes the ranking
design_space.why_material: The score is A100 PCIe time.

design_space.current_assumption: torch 2.7 Blackwell accuracy equals torch 2.4 A100 accuracy.
alternatives: kernel and numeric differences shift accuracy
design_space.why_material: Budget selection relies on local accuracy near the threshold.

hypotheses.proposition: Local proxy speed-ups transfer to the A100 PCIe.
hypotheses.mechanism: Both GPUs are compute-bound on the same kernels.
hypotheses.prediction: Compile-mode gains of 1-3% reproduce on A100 PCIe.

hypotheses.proposition: Accuracy agrees across stacks within 0.1 pp.
hypotheses.mechanism: Same algorithm and fp16 numerics; kernels differ only in rounding.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Paired difference above 0.1 pp at 40+ seeds.

observations.statement: All frontier and climb timing came from a local Blackwell proxy until A100 access arrived via Modal.

probes.method: Modal A100 runs of the pinned stack: widths 512/640/768 and eager (m1), compile modes (m2), and 40-seed budgets 8.25/8.5/8.75 with a local twin on the same seeds (m3, s29).
probes.decision_rule: Adopt A100 timings for R-005 and accept local accuracy if pooled paired difference is within two SE of zero.

question: What are A100 80GB PCIe timings for the frontier candidates, and does dev-stack accuracy transfer to the pinned A100 stack?
synthesis: C1 and C2 hold: compile-mode gains reproduce on A100 PCIe (-1.4% / -2.3%) and accuracy agrees within 0.043 pp (SE 0.035) over 120 paired seeds; host-to-host timing varies 1.5-9%, so timing comparisons must be same-host.
